facts.label: Request
facts.text: View: As of 11 April 2024, Ford Otomotiv Sanayi A.S. / Ford Otosan's published liquidity plan supported conditional ordinary refinancing, not completed funding. Removing either planned source leaves only a small nominal buffer; removing both produces a deficit. Adding the unstressed dividend also produces a deficit despite retaining both sources. Fresh CP-2H therefore changes the funding inference: preliminary/expected note ratings and adequate/comfortable liquidity opinions cannot substitute for placement, usable proceeds, documentation and operating performance.

facts.label: Funding conclusion
facts.text: CP-2H's rating distinctions materially constrain reliance on CP-2G. S&P's issuer rating was preliminary BB- with a Positive outlook, and its proposed unsecured-note rating was preliminary BB-; finalisation required successful issuance, satisfactory final documentation and operating performance consistent with its base case. Material departures could lead to revision or withdrawal. Fitch's BB+/Stable issuer rating was published, but its proposed-note BB+(EXP)/RR4 remained expected and conditional on refinancing completion and conforming documents. Neither rating status proves settlement. Their two-symbol-step difference establishes neither a pricing advantage nor default/LME intent. (S pp.1,3 L173–182; F pp.1–2 L5–8,153–166.)
